Evidence passages:
[deepseek/v3-readme#p0] # DeepSeek-V3 README
[deepseek/v3-readme#p1] ## Overview
[deepseek/v3-readme#p2] DeepSeek-V3 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model featuring 671B total
parameters with 37B activated per token. The model leverages Multi-head Latent
Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, trained on 14.8 trillion tokens
with remarkable training stability and no rollbacks required.
[deepseek/v3-readme#p3] ## Key Architecture Innovations
[deepseek/v3-readme#p4] The model pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy and introduces
Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) objectives for enhanced performance. Training
employed an FP8 mixed precision framework validated at extreme scale, achieving
full computation-communication overlap in cross-node MoE training.
[deepseek/v3-readme#p5] ## Model Availability
[deepseek/v3-readme#p6] Two variants are available on Hugging Face:
[deepseek/v3-readme#p7] - **DeepSeek-V3-Base** — 671B parameters, 128K context.
- **DeepSeek-V3** — 671B parameters (includes 14B MTP module weights), 128K context.
[deepseek/v3-readme#p8] ## Performance Highlights
[deepseek/v3-readme#p9] DeepSeek-V3 demonstrates competitive results against closed-source models:
[deepseek/v3-readme#p10] - Math: MATH-500 (90.2%), AIME 2024 (39.2%)
- Code: HumanEval-Mul (82.6%), Codeforces (51.6 percentile)
- General: MMLU (88.5%), MMLU-Redux (89.1%)
- Long Context: NIAH evaluation validates the 128K context window
- Open-ended: Arena-Hard (85.5), AlpacaEval 2.0 (70.0)
[deepseek/v3-readme#p11] ## Deployment
[deepseek/v3-readme#p12] Recommended inference frameworks include DeepSeek-Infer Demo (FP8/BF16), SGLang,
LMDeploy, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and LightLLM, with support for AMD GPU and Huawei
Ascend NPU.
[deepseek/v3-readme#p13] ## Licensing
[deepseek/v3-readme#p14] The code is released under the MIT License; the model is released under a Model
Agreement supporting commercial use. Access is available via chat.deepseek.com
and the OpenAI-compatible API at platform.deepseek.com.
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p0] # DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p1] ## Abstract
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p2] We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with
671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. To achieve efficient
inference and cost-effective training, DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent
Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated
in DeepSeek-V2. Furthermore, DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free
strategy for load balancing and sets a multi-token prediction training
objective for stronger performance.
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p3] ## Models
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p4] - **DeepSeek-V3** — the main model: 671B total parameters, 37B activated per token.
- **DeepSeek-V3-Base** — the base model variant.
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p5] ## Architecture
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p6] DeepSeek-V3 adopts **Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)** for efficient inference
and **DeepSeekMoE** for cost-effective training. Both MLA and DeepSeekMoE were
thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2. DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an
**auxiliary-loss-free strategy** for load balancing, minimizing the performance
degradation that arises from encouraging load balancing. It also sets a
**Multi-Token Prediction (MTP)** training objective for stronger performance.
Training uses an **FP8 mixed precision** framework.
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p7] ## Claims
[deepseek/v3-technical-report#p8] Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source
models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.
DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training, with
remarkable training stability throughout the process.
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p0] # DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp Model Card
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p1] ## Model Information
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p2] **Model Name:** DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p3] **Base Model:** DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp builds upon V3.1-Terminus by introducing
DeepSeek Sparse Attention — a sparse attention mechanism designed to explore and
validate optimizations for training and inference efficiency in long-context
scenarios.
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p4] ## Architecture Components
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p5] - **DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA):** achieves fine-grained sparse attention for
  the first time, delivering substantial improvements in long-context training
  and inference efficiency while maintaining virtually identical model output
  quality.
- **MLA module:** referenced in the context of RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding)
  implementation details.
- **Indexer module:** referenced alongside architectural specifications for RoPE
  handling.
- **MoE (Mixture of Experts):** the configuration uses 256 experts.
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p6] ## Performance Claims
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p7] The model demonstrates performance on par with V3.1-Terminus across public
benchmarks. Highlighted capabilities include reasoning (MMLU-Pro: 85.0, AIME
2025: 89.3), code generation (Codeforces: 2121), agentic tool use, and
long-context processing efficiency.
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p8] ## License
[deepseek/v3_2-model-card#p9] This repository and the model weights are licensed under the MIT License.
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p0] # DeepSeek-V3.2 Release Notes (2025/12/01)
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p1] ## Models Released
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p2] - **DeepSeek-V3.2** — the official successor to DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, available on
  App, Web, and API platforms.
- **DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale** — an advanced reasoning variant, currently API-only
  without tool-use support.
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p3] ## Reasoning Performance
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p4] DeepSeek-V3.2 offers a balanced trade-off of inference quality vs. length at
GPT-5 performance levels. DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale is positioned to rival
Gemini-3.0-Pro with maxed-out reasoning capabilities, and achieved gold-level
results in IMO, CMO, ICPC World Finals, and IOI 2025.
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p5] ## Agent Training
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p6] The release highlights a new massive agent training data synthesis method
covering 1,800+ environments and 85k+ complex instructions. DeepSeek-V3.2
introduces direct integration of thinking into tool-use workflows, supporting
tool-calling in both thinking and non-thinking modes.
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p7] ## API
[deepseek/v3_2-release#p8] DeepSeek-V3.2 maintains the same usage pattern as its predecessor
DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, with added thinking-in-tool-use support.
DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale is available via a temporary endpoint until December 15th,
2025, with pricing identical to V3.2. Both models are released open-source via
Hugging Face repositories with accompanying technical documentation.
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p0] # DeepSeek-V4 Technical Report
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p1] ## Title
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p2] DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p3] ## Abstract
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p4] We present a preview version of the DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models — DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters
(49B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated) —
both supporting a context length of one million tokens. The DeepSeek-V4 series
incorporates several key upgrades in architecture and optimization: (1) a hybrid
attention architecture that combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and
Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to improve long-context efficiency;
(2) Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) that enhance conventional
residual connections; and (3) the Muon optimizer for faster convergence and
greater training stability.
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p5] ## Model Variants
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p6] - **DeepSeek-V4-Pro** — 1.6T parameters, 49B activated.
- **DeepSeek-V4-Flash** — 284B parameters, 13B activated.
- **DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max** — the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p7] ## Architecture Components
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p8] - Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA)
- Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA)
- Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC)
- Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) design
- Muon optimizer
- One-million-token context length support
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p9] ## Capability Claims
[deepseek/v4-technical-report#p10] DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro,
redefines the state-of-the-art for open models. DeepSeek-V4-Pro requires only 27%
of single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache compared with DeepSeek-V3.2.
The models routinely support one-million-token contexts, thereby making
long-horizon tasks and further test-time scaling more feasible.

[kimi/k2-readme#p0] # Kimi K2 README — Open Agentic Intelligence
[kimi/k2-readme#p1] ## Overview
[kimi/k2-readme#p2] Kimi K2 is a state-of-the-art Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 32 billion activated
parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. The architecture employs the Muon optimizer at
unprecedented scale together with novel optimization techniques for training stability.
[kimi/k2-readme#p3] ## Specifications
[kimi/k2-readme#p4] | Component | Details |
|-----------|---------|
| Total parameters | 1 Trillion |
| Activated parameters | 32 Billion |
| Architecture | Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) |
| Layers | 61 (including 1 dense layer) |
| Experts | 384 total; 8 selected per token |
| Context length | 128K tokens |
| Vocabulary | 160K tokens |
| Attention | MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) |
[kimi/k2-readme#p5] ## Model variants
[kimi/k2-readme#p6] - **Kimi-K2-Base** — foundation model for researchers requiring full control for fine-tuning and
  custom solutions.
- **Kimi-K2-Instruct** — post-trained variant optimized for drop-in, general-purpose chat and
  agentic experiences.
[kimi/k2-readme#p7] ## Capabilities
[kimi/k2-readme#p8] Kimi K2 performs strongly in coding (53.7 on LiveCodeBench), tool use (70.6 on Tau2 retail tasks),
mathematics (69.6 on AIME 2024), and general knowledge (89.5 MMLU), with strong agentic capabilities
including autonomous problem-solving and reasoning.
[kimi/k2-readme#p9] ## Access and license
[kimi/k2-readme#p10] Models are available via Hugging Face in block-fp8 format and through the Moonshot AI API with
OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Recommended inference engines: vLLM, SGLang, KTransformers,
TensorRT-LLM. Code and weights are released under a Modified MIT License.
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p0] # Kimi K2 Technical Report — Open Agentic Intelligence
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p1] ## Abstract
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p2] We introduce Kimi K2, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model with 32 billion activated
parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. We propose the MuonClip optimizer, which improves upon
Muon with a novel QK-clip technique to address training instability while enjoying the advanced token
efficiency of Muon. Based on MuonClip, K2 was pre-trained on 15.5 trillion tokens with zero loss
spike. During post-training, K2 undergoes a multi-stage post-training process, highlighted by a
large-scale agentic data synthesis pipeline and a joint reinforcement learning (RL) stage, where the
model improves its capabilities through interactions with real and synthetic environments.
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p3] Kimi K2 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source non-thinking models, with strengths
in agentic capabilities. Notably, K2 obtains 66.1 on Tau2-Bench, 76.5 on ACEBench (En), 65.8 on
SWE-Bench Verified, and 47.3 on SWE-Bench Multilingual — surpassing most open and closed-sourced
baselines in non-thinking settings. It also exhibits strong capabilities in coding, mathematics, and
reasoning tasks, with 53.7 on LiveCodeBench v6, 49.5 on AIME 2025, 75.1 on GPQA-Diamond, and 27.1 on
OJBench, all without extended thinking.
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p4] ## Model variants
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p5] - **Kimi K2** — the primary model.
- **Kimi-K2-Base** — the base checkpoint.
- **Kimi-K2-Instruct** — the post-trained checkpoint.
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p6] ## Architecture and optimization
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p7] - **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE):** 32B activated of 1T total parameters.
- **MuonClip optimizer:** improves upon Muon with a novel QK-clip technique to address training
  instability, while keeping the token efficiency of Muon. Enabled pre-training on 15.5T tokens with
  zero loss spike.
- **Multi-stage post-training:** a large-scale agentic data synthesis pipeline and a joint
  reinforcement learning (RL) stage.
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p8] ## Departures from prior work
[kimi/k2-technical-report#p9] The MuonClip optimizer is a departure from standard Muon: it introduces a novel QK-clip technique to
address training instability while maintaining Muon's token-efficiency advantages.
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p0] # Kimi-K2-Thinking Model Card
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p1] ## Model identity
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p2] Kimi K2 Thinking is the latest, most capable version of the open-source thinking model, built upon
Kimi K2 — an evolution in the product line.
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p3] ## Architecture components
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p4] - **MoE (Mixture-of-Experts):** 384 total experts with 8 selected per token; 1T total, 32B activated.
- **MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention):** the attention mechanism.
- **SwiGLU:** activation function.
- 61 total layers (including 1 dense layer); 256K context window.
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p5] ## Capability claims
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p6] Kimi K2 Thinking sets a new state-of-the-art on Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), BrowseComp, and other
benchmarks. It demonstrates stable tool-use across 200–300 sequential tool calls, a significant
improvement in multi-step reasoning stability.
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p7] ## Departures from prior versions
[kimi/k2-thinking-model-card#p8] The model introduces native INT4 quantization via Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), achieving
roughly 2x generation-speed improvement without performance degradation — a technical advancement
absent from previous Kimi versions.
